ABOUT.HERO_SUBTITLE: Protecting vulnerable people is everyone's responsibility.
ABOUT.HERO_DESC: An independent, secure citizen platform dedicated to protecting minors and vulnerable people in Cameroon. Free, accessible to all, available on web and Android.
ABOUT.MISSION_P1: Faced with the worrying rise in cases of abuse, kidnappings and disappearances of minors in Cameroon, AlertProche was born from a simple observation: information circulates too slowly, and the community lacks a structured space to act together.
ABOUT.MISSION_P2: Families of missing persons had no centralised place to raise an alert. Witnesses to abuse were afraid to speak out for fear of reprisals. AlertProche addresses each of these situations.
ABOUT.MISSION_P3: Our goal: to free speech, centralise legitimate alerts and structure community mutual aid — protected against doxxing, defamation and media lynching.
ABOUT.MISSION_P4: The platform is open to all cases of vulnerable people: missing children, adults in distress, victims of abuse or exploitation, hospitalised persons whose family cannot be found.
ABOUT.CASES_SUB: AlertProche accepts 4 categories of reports, each with its own urgency level.
ABOUT.CASE_DISPARITION_DESC: Search notice for a missing child or adult. Report with photo, physical description, last known location and circumstances of disappearance.
ABOUT.CASE_ABUS_DESC: Testimony or report of physical, sexual or psychological abuse of a minor or vulnerable person. Carefully moderated to protect privacy.
ABOUT.CASE_APPEL_DESC: Hospitalised person without identified family, individual in precarious or distress situation requiring urgent help. The community can mobilise.
ABOUT.CASE_PREVENTION_DESC: Sharing preventive information: at-risk areas, reported suspicious persons, safety tips for children. Educate to better protect.
ABOUT.FEATURES_SUB: A complete platform built for immediate action and lasting mutual support.
ABOUT.FEAT_SOS_DESC: In immediate danger, trigger an SOS. Your trusted contacts receive a push notification with your real-time GPS location. They can confirm they are on their way or close the alert once the situation is resolved.
ABOUT.FEAT_REPORT_DESC: Structured form with title, detailed description, location, case type and photo. Each post goes through automatic moderation before becoming visible.
ABOUT.FEAT_SEARCH_DESC: Browse the active alert feed. Filter by city, region, case type or keyword.
ABOUT.FEAT_COMMUNITY_DESC: Comment on alerts, share useful information, provide moral or legal support.
ABOUT.FEAT_ANDROID_DESC: Download the AlertProche APK for Android. Receive real-time alerts from your area via push notifications.
ABOUT.FEAT_PHOTO_DESC: Upload a photo of a missing person and our AI searches for similar alerts in the database.
ABOUT.HOW_SUB: Get started in under 2 minutes — simple, fast, secure.
ABOUT.STEP1_DESC: Free registration with a unique username. Your email address remains strictly confidential.
ABOUT.STEP2_DESC: Fill in the form: title, description, location, case type, photo.
ABOUT.STEP3_DESC: Members, volunteers, psychologists and advisors can comment, share the alert and offer help.
ABOUT.STEP4_DESC: Share the alert, contact local authorities, mobilise your network.
ABOUT.SECURITY_TITLE: How does the platform protect you?
ABOUT.SECURITY_SUB: The safety of victims and witnesses is our absolute priority.
ABOUT.SEC_FILTER_DESC: Hateful terms, insults and incitements to violence are automatically detected and blocked before any publication.
ABOUT.SEC_DOXXING_DESC: Phone numbers, ID card numbers and official identifiers are automatically detected and removed from posts to protect people's identity.
ABOUT.SEC_MOD_DESC: A team of volunteer moderators can review, validate or disable any reported content.
ABOUT.SEC_AUTH_DESC: Login via secure JWT. Your password is encrypted, your email is never shared.
ABOUT.SEC_GPS_DESC: SOS location data is only transmitted to your designated trusted contacts.
ABOUT.TECH_P1: AlertProche is an independent citizen initiative, not affiliated with any government or commercial organisation. The platform is developed and maintained by volunteers committed to protecting vulnerable people.
ABOUT.TECH_P2: Data is hosted on secure servers. No personal data is sold or shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
ABOUT.FAQ_A1: Yes, completely free. Registration, publishing, SOS, Android app — everything is free with no advertising.
ABOUT.FAQ_Q2: Do I need an account to view alerts?
ABOUT.FAQ_A2: No. Any visitor can view published alerts without creating an account. An account is only required to publish, comment or use SOS.
ABOUT.FAQ_A3: Each post first goes through an automatic filter (hate content, doxxing). Human moderators then review sensitive cases before publication.
ABOUT.FAQ_A4: SOS requires a connection to send the notification to your contacts. With the Android app, a 2G connection is enough to trigger the GPS alert.
ABOUT.FAQ_Q5: Can I report a case outside Cameroon?
ABOUT.FAQ_A5: The platform is currently focused on Cameroon, but any report with a precise location is accepted.
ABOUT.FAQ_Q6: How do I become a moderator?
ABOUT.FAQ_A6: Moderators are appointed by the administration team from among active and trusted members.
ABOUT.CTA_DESC: Together, we can make a difference for the protection of children and vulnerable people in Cameroon.

PRIVACY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.INTRO: AlertProche is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This document describes how we collect, use and protect your personal data.
PRIVACY.S01_INTRO: When you register and use the platform, we collect the following data:
PRIVACY.S01_ITEM_EMAIL: Email address — used solely for authentication. It is never displayed publicly.
PRIVACY.S01_ITEM_PSEUDO: Username — public identifier chosen by the user. Can be hidden via the anonymisation option.
PRIVACY.S01_ITEM_PASSWORD: Password — stored as a cryptographic hash (bcrypt). We have no access to your plaintext password.
PRIVACY.S01_ITEM_CONTENT: Published content — posts, comments and images submitted voluntarily.
PRIVACY.S01_ITEM_TECH: Technical data — timestamps of posts and connections.
PRIVACY.S01_NOTE: We do not collect GPS location data, tracking cookies, or behavioural data for advertising purposes.
PRIVACY.S02_INTRO: To improve the user experience, AlertProche automatically collects anonymised browsing data.
PRIVACY.S02_ITEM_PAGES: Pages visited — pages viewed and time spent
PRIVACY.S02_ITEM_GEO: Approximate country and city of origin — inferred from IP address
PRIVACY.S02_ITEM_SOURCE: Traffic source — how you found the platform
PRIVACY.S02_NOT_IP: Your plaintext IP address — it is converted to a non-reversible SHA-256 fingerprint
PRIVACY.S02_NOT_PII: Your name, email or any directly identifiable personal information
PRIVACY.S02_NOTE: This data is automatically deleted after 90 days.
PRIVACY.S02_LEGAL_BASIS: This collection is based on AlertProche's legitimate interest in ensuring the platform works correctly, in accordance with data minimisation principles.
PRIVACY.S03_INTRO: Your data is used exclusively to:
PRIVACY.S03_ITEM_SECURITY: Guarantee the security and integrity of the platform
PRIVACY.S03_NO_SALE: Your data is never sold, rented or shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
PRIVACY.S04_DISCLAIMER_DESC: AlertProche is a citizen networking platform. Published content is submitted and controlled by its authors.
PRIVACY.S04_IMAGES_INTRO: Any uploaded image is published under the exclusive responsibility of the user who submits it. By publishing an image, the user guarantees:
PRIVACY.S04_ITEM_RIGHTS: Being the author or holding the necessary rights to publish it
PRIVACY.S04_ITEM_CONSENT: Having obtained the consent of the people photographed
PRIVACY.S04_ITEM_DIGNITY: That the image does not violate image rights or the dignity of persons
PRIVACY.S04_ITEM_ILLEGAL: That the image does not contain illegal content or content that infringes human dignity
PRIVACY.S04_NOTE: AlertProche declines all responsibility for the content of images published by users. Any abuse can be reported via the 'Report' button.
PRIVACY.S05_INTRO: AlertProche offers an anonymous publishing option. When this option is enabled:
PRIVACY.S05_ITEM_PSEUDO: Your username is not displayed on the post or comment
PRIVACY.S05_ITEM_IDENTITY: Your identity is known only to the platform for moderation purposes
PRIVACY.S05_NOTE: Public anonymity does not mean total anonymity. In the event of a report of illegal activity by the competent authorities, identification information may be communicated within the applicable legal framework.
PRIVACY.S06_INTRO: The platform has a two-level moderation system:
PRIVACY.S06_ITEM_AUTO: Automatic moderation — lexical filter (hate speech, insults) and anti-doxxing filter (phone numbers, official identifiers).
PRIVACY.S06_ITEM_HUMAN: Human moderation — moderators and administrators can disable or delete any reported content.
PRIVACY.S06_OUTRO: Any user can report a post via the 'Report' button available on each post.
PRIVACY.S07_ITEM_ACCESS: Right of access — view your data via your personal space
PRIVACY.S07_ITEM_RECTIF: Right of rectification — modify your username from your profile
PRIVACY.S07_ITEM_ERASE: Right to erasure — delete your posts and comments
PRIVACY.S07_ITEM_PORTABILITY: Right to portability — request an export of your data
PRIVACY.S07_OUTRO: Deleting your account results in the anonymisation of your posts in order to preserve the integrity of community alerts.
PRIVACY.S08_INTRO: We implement the following technical measures:
PRIVACY.S08_ITEM_DB: Database hosted on MongoDB Atlas with strict access control
PRIVACY.S08_ITEM_VALIDATION: Validation and sanitisation of all user inputs
PRIVACY.S09_INTRO: For any question relating to this policy, you can contact us via the report form available on each post, or from your personal space.
PRIVACY.S09_NOTE: This policy may be updated. Any significant change will be notified to registered users.
